name: Previous high
derivation: Highs 10, 14, 10, 11, 18, 11, 10. With left=right=1 bar 1 is a swing high confirmed at bar 2, and bar 4 is a higher swing high confirmed at bar 5. The value is carried forward between confirmations - a previous high stays the previous high until a newer one replaces it. Bar 4 is the case worth freezing: the new, higher swing HAPPENS there and the series still reads 14, because at bar 4 that swing is not yet confirmed. Reading 18 at bar 4 would mean using bar 5 to answer a question dated bar 4. An earlier hand-derivation of this vector expected None at bar 4, and the checker caught it - the carry-forward and the confirmation lag interact, and that interaction is easy to get wrong in prose and hard to get wrong once it is a number.
